definitions.explanation: The upper limb of the body from shoulder to hand.
One's ability or skill at something, especially a craft or profession.

examples.japanese: {腕|うで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{腕|うで}⟦{時計|どけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧{腕|うで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}くて→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦{動|うご}かせません→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧。
examples.english: My right arm hurts and I can't move it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{腕|うで}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抱|だ}いて→抱く：02131_daku⟧、⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}きました→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: Holding the child in my arms, I walked slowly.

examples.japanese: {腕|うで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I practice every day to improve my skills.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腕|うで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: That person has excellent work skills.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腕|うで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She practices three hours every day to improve her piano skills.

notes: {腕|うで} refers to the entire arm, not just a part of it. It's also commonly used to mean 'skill' or 'ability,' especially in contexts of craftsmanship: {腕|うで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (skilled), {腕|うで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧ (to improve one's skills). {腕|うで}⟦{時計|どけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧ is a wristwatch, {腕|うで}⟦{組|ぐ}み→組：02668_kumi⟧ is folding one's arms.
